```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(loo)
library(tidybayes)
library(posterior)
library(purrr)
library(knitr)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

set.seed(1007)
```

This notebook will analyse the outputs of the Bayesian models fitted in
the previous notebook.

Analysis will include: (1) LOO model comparison, (2) phylogenetic ICC
calculation.

```{r All nedded functions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# LOO check
loo_safe <- function(fit, ndraws = 1000, moment_match = FALSE) {
  # Try regular PSIS-LOO on a thinned log-lik; fall back to add_criterion
  tryCatch(
    {
      ll <- log_lik(fit, ndraws = ndraws)
      loo(ll)
      },
    error = function(e) {
      if (moment_match) {
        add_criterion(fit, "loo", moment_match = TRUE, ndraws = ndraws)$criteria$loo
        } else {
          stop(e)
        }
      }
  )
}

# tidy loo outputs
loo_compare_tidy <- function(loos_named) {
  cmp <- loo::loo_compare(loos_named)
  df <- as.data.frame(cmp)
  df$model <- rownames(df)
  rownames(df) <- NULL
  dplyr::relocate(df, model) |>
    dplyr::rename(elpd_diff = elpd_diff, se_diff = se_diff)
}

# Pareto-k diagnostics summary
pareto_summary <- function(loo_obj) {
  k <- loo::pareto_k_values(loo_obj)
  tibble(
    n = length(k),
    frac_k_gt_0.5 = mean(k > 0.5),
    frac_k_gt_0.7 = mean(k > 0.7),
    max_k = max(k)
    )
}

# Pick LOO-best model
pick_best_model <- function(loo_tbl) {
  loo_tbl |> arrange(desc(-elpd_diff)) |> slice(1) |> pull(model)
}

# Compute ICC_phylo from a brms fit
icc_phylo_brms <- function(fit, other_re_prefixes = c("FG","CAS","latin")) {
  dr <- as_draws_df(fit)
  
  # phylogenetic variance (intercept RE)
  v_phy <- dr$`sd_phylo__Intercept`^2
  
  # residual variance
  v_res <- dr$sigma^2
  
  # sum other random-intercept variances if present
  v_other <- 0
  for (p in other_re_prefixes) {
    nm <- paste0("sd_", p, "__Intercept")
    if (nm %in% names(dr)) v_other <- v_other + dr[[nm]]^2
  }
  
  icc <- v_phy / (v_phy + v_other + v_res)
  tibble(icc = icc)
}

```

# 1. Load Bayesian model output files
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
chem_groups <- c("Arthropod_control", "Auxiliary_other",
"Fungal_control", "Vertebrate_control", "Plant_control", "Mixed_multitarget")

model_ids <- c("M1","M2","M3","M4")

fits <- list()
for (g in chem_groups) {
  fits[[g]] <- list()
  for (m in model_ids) {
    path <- here("model_output/bayesian_models", paste0("fit_", m, "_", g, ".rds"))
    fits[[g]][[m]] <- readRDS(path)
  }
}

for (g in chem_groups) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", g))
  mods <- fits[[g]]
  names(mods) <- paste0("M", seq_along(mods))

  for (nm in names(mods)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s (%s)\n\n", nm, g))
    out <- capture.output(print(summary(mods[[nm]])))
    cat("```\n", paste(out, collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n")
  }
}

```

# 2. LOO check
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
nd <- 1000
moment_match <- TRUE

loo_results <- list()
loo_tables  <- list()
k_diags     <- list()

out_dir <- here::here("model_output", "loo_check")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

for (g in chem_groups) {
  message("Computing LOO for: ", g)
  lm <- list()
  for (m in names(fits[[g]])) {
    message("              ", m)
    lm[[m]] <- loo_safe(fits[[g]][[m]], ndraws = nd, moment_match = moment_match)
  }
  loo_results[[g]] <- lm
  
  # Tidy LOO comparision table
  tbl <- loo_compare_tidy(lm)
  loo_tables[[g]] <- tbl
  
  # Pareto-k diagnostics
  kd <- purrr::map_dfr(
    names(lm),
    ~ pareto_summary(lm[[.x]]) |> dplyr::mutate(model = .x),
    .id = NULL
  ) |>
    dplyr::relocate(model)
  k_diags[[g]] <- kd
  
  # ---- save per group ----
  purrr::iwalk(lm, ~ saveRDS(.x, file = file.path(out_dir, paste0("loo_", g, "_", .y, ".rds"))))
  readr::write_csv(tbl, file.path(out_dir, paste0("loo_table_", g, ".csv")))
  readr::write_csv(kd,  file.path(out_dir, paste0("pareto_diag_", g, ".csv")))
}

# save all groups together
saveRDS(loo_tables,  file.path(out_dir, "loo_tables_all.rds"))
saveRDS(k_diags,     file.path(out_dir, "pareto_diags_all.rds"))

```

Print LOO tables and Pareto-k diagnostics

```{r}
out_dir <- here("model_output", "loo_check")

loo_tables <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "loo_tables_all.rds"))
k_diags    <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "pareto_diags_all.rds"))

for (g in chem_groups) {
  print(loo_tables[[g]])
}

for (g in chem_groups) {
  print(k_diags[[g]])
}
```

# 3. Choose the best model from LOO and then calculate phylogenetic ICC

We calculate the phylognetic signal
$ICC=\sigma_{\text{phy}}^{2} / (\sigma_{\text{phy}}^{2} + \sigma_{\text{res}}^{2})$
from the LOO-best model for each chemical group.

```{r}
icc_draws <- list()
icc_summ  <- list()
winners   <- list()

for (g in chem_groups) {
  best <- loo_tables[[g]] |> filter(elpd_diff == 0) |> slice(1) |> pull(model)
  winners[[g]] <- best
  fit_best <- fits[[g]][[best]]
  
  # compute ICC from best model
  icc_df <- icc_phylo_brms(fit_best, other_re_prefixes = c("FG","CAS"))
  icc_draws[[g]] <- icc_df |> mutate(group = g, model = best)
  icc_summ[[g]] <- icc_df |>
    summarise(
      median = median(icc),
      l95 = quantile(icc, 0.025),
      u95 = quantile(icc, 0.975)
      ) |>
    mutate(group = g, model = best)
}

icc_draws_df <- bind_rows(icc_draws)
icc_summ_df  <- bind_rows(icc_summ)

icc_dir <- here("model_output", "ICC_phylo")

saveRDS(icc_draws_df, file.path(icc_dir, "icc_phylo_draws.rds"))
saveRDS(icc_summ_df,  file.path(icc_dir, "icc_phylo_summary.rds"))
saveRDS(winners,      file.path(icc_dir, "icc_winners_by_group.rds"))

```

```{r}
kable(icc_summ_df)
```
